# Support

Welcome to the BFFX community!

## Getting Help

- **Documentation**: Check our [docs/](docs/) directory.
- **GitHub Issues**: For bug reports and feature requests.
- **Discussions**: For general questions and architectural advice.

## Support Status

BFFX is currently in **Beta**. Support is provided on a best-effort basis by the maintainers and the community. There are no formal SLAs at this time.

## Contributing

If you'd like to help improve BFFX, please see our [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
